material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - words we say wrong
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll fix words that almost everybody says with one syllable too many. They’re... …TRICKY WORDS! The spelling promises more than it gives: recipe

Some words lose a syllable and some hide a silent letter completely. Reading them out loud from the spelling is exactly how the mistake happens.
